mapper.select:
select , bmi.id as organi_id, bmi.name as organi_name, region.id as reg_id, region.name as reg_name, brg.id as group_id, brg.name as group_name from base_role_info bri left join base_organization_info bmi ON bmi.id = bri.org_id left join base_region_info region ON region.id = bri.region_id left join base_role_group_link brgl on brgl.role_id = bri.id left join base_role_group brg on brg.id = brgl.group_id where bri.id in ( select ri.id from (select id from base_role_info bri2
and bri.org_id in (WITH RECURSIVE child_nodes AS (SELECT bmi.id FROM base_organization_info bmi WHERE id = #{orgId} UNION SELECT bmi2.id FROM base_organization_info bmi2 JOIN child_nodes pn ON pn.id = bmi2.parent_id) SELECT * FROM child_nodes)
and bri2.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
group by bri2.id order by bri2.add_time desc, bri2.id desc limit #{pageSize} offset #{pageNo})ri) order by bri.add_time desc, bri.id desc

select count(id) from base_role_info bri2
and bri2.org_id in (WITH RECURSIVE child_nodes AS (SELECT bmi.id FROM base_organization_info bmi WHERE id = #{orgId} UNION SELECT bmi2.id FROM base_organization_info bmi2 JOIN child_nodes pn ON pn.id = bmi2.parent_id) SELECT * FROM child_nodes)
and bri2.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')

select , bmi.id as menu_id, bmi.parent_id as menu_parent_id, bmi.name as menu_name, bmi.open_url as menu_open_url, bmi.icon as menu_icon, bmi.is_frame as menu_is_frame, bmi.order_num as menu_order_num, bmi.is_display as menu_is_display, brin.id as rights_id, brin.name as rights_name, bmi.type as menu_type from base_role_info bri left join base_role_menu brm on bri.id = brm.role_id left join base_menu_info bmi on brm.menu_id = bmi.id left join base_menu_rights_link bmrl on bmrl.menu_id = bmi.id and bmrl.role_id = #{id} left join base_rights_info brin on brin.id = bmrl.rights_id where bri.id = #{id} order by bmi.id

select
, boi.id as organi_id, boi.name as organi_name, bregi.id as reg_id, bregi.name as reg_name, brg.id as group_id, brg.name as group_name, bmi.id as menu_id, bmi.name as menu_name, bmi.parent_id as menu_parent_id from base_role_info bri left join base_organization_info boi on boi.id = bri.org_id left join base_region_info bregi on bregi.id = bri.region_id left join base_role_group_link brgl on brgl.role_id = bri.id left join base_role_group brg on brg.id = brgl.group_id left join base_role_menu brm on bri.id = brm.role_id left join base_menu_info bmi on bmi.id = brm.menu_id where bri.id = #{id}
